name: Diana, Princess of Wales
role: Princess of Wales (1981-1996), royal patron of charities and landmine-ban campaigner
summary: Diana avoided party politics and stated few positions on contested policy questions. Her public record is charity work (HIV/AIDS, homelessness, leprosy, mental health, landmine clearance), and she backed an international ban on anti-personnel landmines in 1997, which drew criticism from some government figures. None of her recorded statements addresses the test statements closely enough to answer them.
